newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Snap-On started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Snap-On started as buy.

text.p: --NatWest Securities said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Snap-On Inc with a buy rating, noting it disagrees with the notion there is no growth left in Snap-On.

--"We see potential for Snap-On to be the first in the market to offer an integrated diagnostic, inventory, pricing and billing system," NatWest noted in a report. "In the meantime, we expect the company to bring to the bottom line substantial productivity improvements."
--NatWest estimates EPS for the company of $3.20 in 1996 and $3.66 in 1997.
